top_findings: Most assigned files are meaningful and deterministic; no broad assertion weakening, retries, sleeps, budget reductions, or migration regressions were found.
OfflineCollectionJourneyTest likely samples screenshot coordinates incorrectly: lines 146-155 omit the window-to-screen offset that OfflineImageDiagnostics computes at lines 97-103.
JourneySourceRegistry hides creator and related request ownership at lines 43-44, weakening the ability of navigation journeys to prove source/membership policy.
SearchNavigationJourneyTest's real swipe loop at lines 217-238 is the main device-layout-sensitive interaction; retain the gesture but add condition-based settling.
PostDownloadProcessRecoveryDeviceTest can leak token-scoped native rows/files if the read phase fails before lines 94-98; host-level failure cleanup is preferable.
Hitomi live transport and benchmark resources/source are intentionally deferred. Explicitly opt-in live coverage should remain outside the default connected-device lane.
